checked_decisions: Slot 19-24 meaning verified against source: joint/combined two-unit operation, goal is to secure every base in the operation area, motherships deployed in the area (losing one fails the operation, keep fighting while covering them), battle situation can change mid-fight so split roles sensibly, mission time is limited, good luck.
Slot 20/21 tag order verified identical to source, including the two separate <color(6)> spans in slot 21 ('sunk' and 'failure') and their nested move/picture/refer clusters.
Slot 21: draft's own note documents compressing the sentence to fit under 128 visible chars without dropping meaning - verified length now 117 visible chars, well within limit.

All commands identical in count/order vs source in every row (verified programmatically, after the j-glyph fix); ASCII-only, no newline, 128-char limit respected, no lowercase j/q (after fix), no bare %.
